attributes.board_name: Alaska State Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least half of the hours from courses offered by an accredited academic institution or a board-approved professional organization listed in 12 AAC 54.715(a) (e.g. AOTA, NBCOT); content must relate directly to occupational therapy (AS 08.84.190). 1 contact hour = 50 min; 1 CEU = 10 contact hours; 1 semester credit = 15, 1 quarter credit = 10 contact hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than 12 months of the concluding period: 12 contact hours, or passing the NBCOT exam during that period, or current NBCOT certification.
rules.alternatives: Current NBCOT certification (OTR or COTA) fulfils the CE requirement (12 AAC 54.710(g)). Separately, renewal also needs 60 hours of occupational therapy practice in the period, or an alternative: 40 extra CE contact hours, or a 150-hour board-approved internship, among others (12 AAC 54.705).
rules.audit_note: Board audits renewal applications at its discretion after each renewal period; audited licensees have 30 days to submit documentation. Keep records 3 years. Do not send certificates unless requested.
rules.notes: All licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years. Military active duty: half of CE waived for 6+ months of service in the period, all CE for 12+ months. The board discussed a CE rule rewrite in 2025–2026 (draft wording of 32 hours); not adopted in the code as read on the check date.
